newsitem.title: USA: GKN bid for Sinter Metals cleared.
newsitem.headline: GKN bid for Sinter Metals cleared.

text.p: GKN Plc said Wednesday the tender offer by its unit, GKN Powder Mettalurgy Inc, for all class A and class B common shares of Sinter Metals Inc has received antitrust clearance from U.S. federal regulators.
The tender offer for $37 a share, which it launched on May 2, will expire on May 30, unless extended, it said.
Sinter Metals produces precision pressed powder metal parts for use principally in the automotive, lawn and garden, power tool and home appliance industries.

GKN is a global industrial company which designs, develops and manufactures automotive and agritechnical components as well as aerospace and defense products and provides a range of industrial services.
